nodes.label: Arbor / Toward Generalist Autonomous Research via Hypothesis-Tree Refinement
nodes.author: Jiajie Jin et al.

nodes.label: Hypothesis Tree Refinement (HTR)
nodes.rationale: Separates a long-lived coordinator holding durable state (hypothesis+artifact+evidence+insight per node) from short-lived isolated executors, so global strategy survives beyond any single conversation window or executor context limit.

nodes.label: Held-out admission gate
nodes.rationale: Only merges a candidate into the working-best artifact if it improves a held-out test evaluator (not just the development evaluator used during search), defending against overfitting to the feedback signal used during search, demonstrated concretely by the Terminal-Bench dev/test divergence case.
